description: Access directory, access point health, manual pinning, manifest refresh and recovery links for the network diagnostics page.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Directory serial and source, manifest timestamps, staleness, development mode, the current region, cell, access point and protocol, the manual pin, refresh progress and recovery state.

methods.name: listAccessPoints
methods.description: Every access point of the home cell with its RTT on the current network, breaker state, and whether it is current or pinned.

methods.name: pin
methods.description: Pins one access point (24 hours, cleared on app restart) and switches to it at once when it is not current, without signing in again.

methods.name: unpin
methods.description: Clears the manual pin; automatic selection decides at the next natural boundary.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Runs one manifest refresh round now (or waits for the round in flight) and reports every source it tried. During recovery the round tries every tier.

methods.name: importRecovery
methods.description: Imports a recovery link or QR code. A bad link is an expected result carried in outcome and code, not an error; only a configuration problem throws.

methods.name: exportDiagnostics
methods.description: Diagnostics JSON for support: access status, access point health, the locally hashed network fingerprint and warnings. Holds no tokens, users or message content.
